qa.title: Q761 (Jun. 28, 2024)
qa.question: If I have this follower on my field with 20 Armageddon counters, and an opponent has a Lyrial, Archer Throne on their field, will their leader take 10 damage from this follower's Strike ability?
qa.answer: Yes. Since effects are applied in written order, this follower's Strike ability will destroy the enemy Lyrial, Archer Throne before dealing damage to each enemy leader. Therefore, Lyrial, Archer Throne's ability will not take effect.

qa.title: Q760 (Jun. 28, 2024)
qa.question: This follower is on my field with 30 Armageddon counters, Opponent A has an Ancient Protector on their field, and their leader has 10 defense or less. What happens when I attack with this follower?
qa.answer:
First, you apply the effects of the Strike ability in written order, so you destroy each enemy follower on the field and then deal 10 damage to each enemy leader. At this point, Opponent A's leader's defense has become 0 or less, so their Ancient Protector's ability triggers and becomes pending until the Strike ability is fully resolved.

Then, you resolve the rest of the Strike ability, causing each opponent to lose the game, excluding Opponent A because they still have Ancient Protector on their field.

Finally, Ancient Protector's ability is resolved, setting Opponent A's leader's defense to 1.

qa.title: Q759 (Jun. 28, 2024)
qa.question: I'm playing against 3 other players. I have this follower on my field with 30 Armageddon counters, and one of my opponents has an Ancient Protector on their field. What happens to the other 2 opponents when I attack with this follower?
qa.answer: Ancient Protector prevents its controller from losing, so the two opponents without it on their field lose the game as a result of this follower's Strike ability.

qa.title: Q344 (Dec. 8, 2023)
qa.question: When an ability refers to the cost of a card that was played for a different number of play points than its displayed cost, does it refer to that different number?
qa.answer:
No. It refers to the cost displayed on the card. For example, when referring to the cost of a Flame Destroyer, the number used is always 9, even if it was played for 6, 3, or 0 play points.

Effects that change the number of play points it costs to play a card don't change the cost information of the card. When an ability refers to how much a card "costs" or its "base cost," it always refers to the cost displayed on the card. Note that, when referring to the cost of an evolved follower, you use the cost of its unevolved form.

qa.title: Q723 (Jun. 14, 2024)
qa.question: Does this amulet's ability mean my leader can't take more than a total of 4 damage on the turn I activate it?
qa.answer:
No. Any single instance of damage greater than 4 dealt to your leader that turn is reduced to 4.

For example, if your leader takes 5 damage twice, both instances are reduced to 4 for a total of 8 damage. If your leader takes 6 damage and then 3 damage, the first instance is reduced to 4 and the second is unaffected, giving a total of 7 damage.
